caveats: A simulation with chosen, not estimated, parameters: results describe the simulator.
Households hold one fixed passive portfolio inside the world; the allocation-rule comparison of Finding 25 replays a finished world.
The crisis regime is still an exogenous random switch; sovereign default, bank failure and inequality respond to it but do not cause it.
Deposit insurance is paid from the budget at once, with no premiums, fund or resolution authority; the tax system is one rate with a progressivity exponent.
Impulse responses are means over seeds of the difference between paired worlds; a cell that excludes zero is a working channel, not a real-economy elasticity.
